It offers a wide range of gain, from a clean boost to a full-on distortion. The pedal is known for its ability to reproduce the tone of an old tube amp. The BYOC Blue Overdrive is built with high-quality metal film resistors and capacitors, as well as true bypass, which reduces noise and eliminates tone loss when the pedal is not in use. The BD-2 circuit is also highly modifiable, and the BYOC Blue Overdrive is designed to be easier to modify than the stock BOSS pedal. There are many BD-2 mods available for those looking to customize their tone. Summary created by AI from the original source.
